problem: I keep scrolling my phone instead of studying
why: Odysseus doesn't rely on willpower; he ties himself to the mast in advance, like putting the phone in another room.

problem: I can't stop checking social media
why: The Sirens' song is designed to be irresistible; the answer is a commitment device, not more resolve.

problem: I'm trying to quit smoking
why: Plan for the craving before it arrives and ask friends to bind you tighter if you beg.

problem: I keep breaking my diet at night
why: Remove the temptation before the moment comes, the way the crew plugged their ears with wax.

problem: I procrastinate on everything and feel stuck
why: Comfort that makes you forget your goal is the lotus; someone has to drag you back to the ship.

problem: I've been binge watching shows for weeks and lost my motivation
why: The lotus-eaters weren't hurt, they just stopped caring about home. Numbing works the same way.

problem: I play video games all day instead of looking for work
why: Pleasant distraction that quietly replaces the goal; leave quickly before the next bite.

problem: My job pays well but I'm miserable and feel trapped
why: Calypso offered paradise and immortality, and Odysseus still wept on the shore. A golden cage is still a cage.

problem: I'm thinking about quitting my comfortable job to start something risky
why: Odysseus chooses a raft and the open sea over comfort because home is what he wants.

problem: I'm in a relationship that's fine but I don't feel like myself
why: Calypso loved him, but staying meant giving up who he was.

problem: I just moved to a new city and don't know anyone
why: Odysseus washed up on Scheria knowing no one and got home by asking a stranger for help.

problem: I'm too proud to ask for help
why: The greatest hero in Greece had to ask a young princess for clothes and directions.

problem: I failed and have to start over from nothing
why: Naked and shipwrecked, Odysseus rebuilt from nothing but his story.

problem: My boss is a bully and much more powerful than me
why: You can't overpower a Cyclops; Odysseus outthinks him.

problem: I won an argument and then bragged about it and now everyone is mad
why: Shouting his name from the ship turned a clever escape into Poseidon's ten-year grudge.

problem: I want revenge on someone who hurt me
why: The urge to be known as the one who won is exactly what brought Poseidon's curse.

problem: I'm burned out because I do everything myself at work
why: Odysseus held the rudder for nine days, fell asleep in sight of home, and lost it all.

problem: My group project team doesn't trust me
why: The crew opened the bag because no one told them what was in it; secrecy breeds suspicion.

problem: I was so close to my goal and then everything fell apart
why: Ithaca was in sight, the stubble fires visible, and the winds blew them back. He bore it and kept going.

problem: My friends keep pressuring me to party and drink
why: Circe's feast made men forget home; Odysseus walked in protected and set his terms.

problem: I'm in a toxic relationship and losing myself
why: Circe's drugs made men forget their homes. Set boundaries and make them swear before you trust.

problem: I keep staying somewhere I should have left a year ago
why: They stayed a whole year until the crew said it was time to think about home.

problem: My mom died last year and I can't move on
why: Odysseus tried three times to embrace his mother's ghost. Grief is allowed to hurt.

problem: I only care about being famous and successful
why: Achilles, the most glorious hero, says he'd rather be a poor servant alive than king among the dead.

problem: I need advice about my future and don't know where to turn
why: Odysseus went to the edge of the world to ask Teiresias the way forward.

problem: I have to choose between two bad options
why: Scylla or Charybdis: choose the loss you can survive and row hard.

problem: I have to lay off people from my team
why: Odysseus sacrificed six men to save the ship and grieved for them; leadership sometimes means choosing a loss.

problem: I'm tempted to cheat on my exam because I'm desperate
why: The crew broke their promise because they were hungry, and the shortcut sank the ship.

problem: I'm impatient and keep spending money I should be saving
why: The cattle of the Sun: the shortcut that feels harmless when you're hungry costs everything.

problem: I'm too shy to stand up to my roommates who take advantage of me
why: Athena told Telemachus to stop waiting and call the assembly himself.

problem: I feel like everyone else is more grown up and confident than me
why: Telemachus started powerless and found his voice by taking his father's seat and speaking.

problem: I'm going home after years away and I'm nervous about reconnecting with my family
why: Odysseus didn't recognise Ithaca at first and rebuilt trust slowly, with proof, not speeches.

problem: I'm trying to rebuild trust with my partner after a long time apart
why: Penelope tests him with the olive-tree bed; trust comes back through shared truths.
